name: constraints
text: how convincingly it meets the brief's hard rules: buildable within the described system without replacing it, and testable with the described benchmark

name: gain
text: how much it would improve the system's top ideas relative to a single strong agent's own top 3

name: measurable
text: how cleanly its effect could be isolated and detected, preferably by measured outcomes rather than opinion

name: feasibility
text: effort to build and extra token cost to run and evaluate, relative to the benefit

name: pursue
text: would an engineer maintaining this system spend a week building and testing it?
